summary_en: This trial tests toripalimab, an immunotherapy drug, after surgery to reduce the risk of cancer recurrence in patients with mismatch repair deficient stage IIB, IIC, or III colon cancer. Toripalimab is given into a vein every 3 weeks for 6 months (8 doses), followed by surveillance with blood tests, CT scans, and colonoscopy until 5 years after surgery. The main outcome is not stated; this is a Phase 2 trial.
summary_es: Este ensayo evalúa toripalimab, un medicamento de inmunoterapia, después de la cirugía para reducir el riesgo de recurrencia del cáncer en pacientes con cáncer de colon en estadio IIB, IIC o III con deficiencia de reparación de errores de apareamiento. El toripalimab se administra en una vena cada 3 semanas durante 6 meses (8 dosis), seguido de vigilancia con análisis de sangre, tomografías computarizadas y colonoscopias hasta 5 años después de la cirugía. El resultado principal no se indica; este es un ensayo de Fase 2.
who_for: Resected stage IIB, IIC, or III dMMR or MSI-H colon cancer (AJCC 8).
Complete (R0) resection 4 to 12 weeks before the first dose.
Tissue sample from the surgical specimen is available.
not_for: Neoadjuvant treatment for dMMR colon cancer.
Prior treatment with any immune checkpoint inhibitor.
History of pneumonitis needing steroids or interstitial lung disease.
Active hepatitis B or C, or autoimmune disease treated systemically in the past 2 years.
